title: Cute Toddler in Plaid Overalls at Playground, 1969 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage square black-and-white snapshot from July 1969 featuring an adorable toddler standing outdoors in bright sunlight. The child is dressed in mid-century children's fashion, wearing a white collared shirt underneath plaid overall shorts and light-colored socks. Behind the boy is a circular wooden merry-go-round or repurposed cable spool on a sand and paved schoolyard or park surface, casting a prominent round shadow. The left border is mechanically stamped with the processing date 'JULY 1969', a momentous summer in American history marked by the Apollo 11 Moon landing.
